claims.claim: Neatly used Disc of Hitman 2 PS4 available.
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows the PS4 game case/cover with “HITMAN 2” branding; it does not confirm the disc is included or its condition.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the disc inside the case (or the disc itself) and the case contents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as case-only / disc not confirmed.

risks.risk: Disc condition may be poor (scratches, unreadable surface).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc surface (both sides) under light, plus a short video of it being inserted and loading on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to work / higher chance of needing replacement.

risks.proof: Photo(s) showing everything inside the case (manual/inserts) laid out or clearly visible.

risks.risk: Cover/case damage may be worse than shown (cracks, bent plastic, heavy wear).
risks.proof: Multiple angles of the case and spine, including close-ups of any cracks/bends and the hinge area.

risks.risk: Region/compatibility may differ (though PS4 label is shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the disc label/region markings (or back cover region info) and confirmation it runs on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard PS4 compatibility only, with no region guarantee.

proof_requests: Show the disc (or confirm it’s included) with clear close-up photos of both sides.
Show the case contents (manual/inserts) to confirm completeness.
Provide a short video of the game being tested on a PS4 (insert → load screen → menu).
Take close-up photos of the case/spine/hinge for any cracks or heavy wear.
response.reason: The witness confirms the PS4 Hitman 2 case/cover, but key value drivers (disc included and condition, completeness, and test status) are not shown. Without those, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
